zh: 号外！阿甲开源新工具，一晚上收了三百颗星！
en: Extra! A-Jia open-sources a tool: three hundred stars overnight!

zh: 深圳急电！周末聚会，接龙十二人！
en: Shenzhen calling! A weekend meet-up: twelve sign up!

zh: 杭州、北京、上海的群友，也在路上！
en: Hangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai: all on their way!

zh: 深夜急电：服务器又挂了！
en: Midnight wire: the server's down again!

zh: 重启三次，零点十分，阿丙修好了！
en: Three reboots later, ten past midnight, A-Bing fixed it!

zh: 新工具上线，群友纷纷点星！
en: The new tool is out, and the stars pour in!

zh: 老王表示：明天我也写一个！
en: Lao Wang says: tomorrow I'll write one too!

zh: 夜深了，全群齐声：早点睡！
en: Late at night, the whole group: get some sleep!

zh: 天气预报：深圳晴，北京小雪，注意保暖！
en: The weather: sun in Shenzhen, snow in Beijing. Keep warm!

zh: 二十三点五十八分，最后一条：明天见。
en: Eleven fifty-eight. The last word: see you tomorrow.
